text:
anika: quick idea - opt-in SDK sampling that prioritizes expensive routes. goal: better quota breakdowns without changing defaults.

ryan: how invasive? header-only?

anika: header-only + handshake version: X-RW-SAMPLE-V:1 and hint like X-RW-SAMPLE:HINT=route=embed;mode=prefer. server accepts hints but falls back if absent.

lee: big win for billing insights. caveat: console charts will look different for canary tenants. need normalized overlay and a parity mapping job.

opsbot: FYI incident-1822 linked (header-casing led to attr loss). add header-casing tests across py/ts/go.

telemetry-bot: recommend emitting both raw_sampled and normalized metrics for 14d during canary. include mapping job to merge series for historical continuity.

anika: rollout plan: 1) server hint-only logging mode on canary infra, 2) SDK minor opt-in via env REDWOOD_ROUTE_SAMPLING=route-aware, startup warning log, 3) tenant toggle in console + raw/normalized view, 4) parity job for 2w, then consider default in major.

ryan: keep header stable but add versioning so proxies can fallback. include rollback env var REDWOOD_ROUTE_SAMPLING=off. I'll take compatibility review.

lee: i'll own console QA and a short FAQ for PM/CS explaining chart deltas.

anika: thanks. i'll open a draft PR with opt-in flag + tests by EOD and post link here.

opsbot: ticket created RW-9344 (sdk-route-sampling) and PR stub rw/sdk-config#520.
